name: bld5_mantel_equality_connected
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hG : G.CliqueFree 3) (he : 4 * G.edgeFinset.card = Fintype.card V ^ 2) (hn : 2 ≤ Fintype.card V) : G.Connected
closed: ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hG : G.CliqueFree 3) (he : 4 * G.edgeFinset.card = Fintype.card V ^ 2) (hn : 2 ≤ Fintype.card V), G.Connected
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld4_mantel_equality_complete_bipartite: it gives s with 2|s| = n and Adj x y ↔ (x ∈ s ↔ y ∉ s). Since n ≥ 2, both s and its complement are non-empty; pick u ∈ s, w ∉ s. Any x ∈ s is adjacent to w and any x ∉ s is adjacent to u, and u ~ w, so every two vertices are joined by a walk of length ≤ 3 through u, w: G is preconnected and V is non-empty.
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [inst_2 : DecidableRel G.Adj], G.CliqueFree 3 → 4 * G.edgeFinset.card = Fintype.card V ^ 2 → 2 ≤ Fintype.card V → G.Connected
